description: Multi-mode (7-harmonic) CO2 Rabi comparison vs Bonini 2024 Fig. 3B. Harmonic ladder omega_a=(a/3)*omega_res, lambda_a=(a/3)*lambda_res, a=1..7, resonant a=3, chi included. The resonant-mode Rabi LP/UP from NEP / ab initio q-mode / ab initio e-mode MD are compared against the ab initio panel-B branches (data/CO2_Fig3_panelB.dat). These 'lambdas' are the ab initio / reference grid; NEP uses a finer grid (generate_branches.py). steps/tolerances are as in compare_with_bonini2024.
